title: Spotify refresh token in a token response member
summary: A synthetic refresh token in the refresh_token member of an authorization token response, in a raw HTTP response, a pretty-printed JSON file and a compact one-line JSON object.
rationale: Spotify returns a refresh_token with the access token in the token response of the user-authorized flows, and the token is exchanged for new access tokens; for registered apps it lives 6 months and refreshing does not extend it. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width, so the member name is the only identifying context and no bare-value rule is implied. The refresh token belongs to token request and response fields, not to a resource API Bearer header. The extent is the string value of the member and excludes the quotes.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the string value of the refresh_token member of a Spotify token response is treated as a credential. Spotify documents that the response returns a refresh token (carrier existence only); the member value admission and extent are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: A refresh token is a security credential that allows client applications to obtain new access tokens without requiring users to reauthorize the application.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy.
